items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: That was the band. That was my band, that Ormond.

ctx.x: He used to use the Holy Ghost's bar, I play when I was playing. Sure. He'd play a solo trumpet. No, I didn't know. And he, that was a powerful man.

In other words, he kept all the music and everything. He was a good reader. Strictly most of the reader. He had the Eureka. Yeah, he enjoyed that Eureka then. He was really Carnage in the band then on Trinidad. No, Willie had died. He was out of there then. He was out of there. But I'm more sure that Landry had played with Carnage. He had been a member of the Eureka. Yeah, yeah, yeah. For a long time. He and Rodgers both. He and Ernest Rodgers both. He's been members of Eureka for years. I never had a chance to…
Did that Ormond come through? That's the move.
